requirements.text: Browser toolbars shall be collapsed and expanded.
Folders shall be added to the personal toolbar and their contents shall still function as links.
Browser navigation toolbar buttons shall execute appropriately.

reference_cases.title: TC-182
reference_cases.description:
INITIAL CONDITIONS
1. All of the browser's toolbars(3) must be visible.
2. Make sure they are all visible by selecting the top level 'View' menu and looking at the Toolbars submenu. The Navigation Toolbar, Personal Toolbar, and Taskbar should all have checks next to their names.

STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Click the small triangle at the far left of the Bookmarks(Personal) Toolbar to collapse it. Click again to expand it.
2. Click the small triangle at the far left of the Navigation Toolbar to collapse it. Click again to expand it.
3. Collapse the Bookmarks Toolbar again. Collapse the Navigation Toolbar again.
4. Expand the Navigation Toolbar once more, expand the Bookmarks Toolbar as well(reverse order).

EXPECTED RESULTS
1. Each click of the triangle widget should alternately show and hide the corresponding toolbar.
2. For steps(2 & 3), expanding the toolbars in the reverse order from that in which they were collapsed should not affect their positioning upon expansion.

reference_cases.title: TC-183
reference_cases.description:
INITIAL CONDITIONS
1. All of the browser's toolbars(3) must be visible.
2. Make sure they are all visible by selecting the top level "View" menu and looking at the Toolbars submenu. The Navigation Toolbar, Personal Toolbar, and Taskbar should all have checks next to their names.

STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Select Bookmarks|Manage Bookmarks.
2. Open the "Personal Toolbar Folder". Add a new folder to it, File|New Folder.
3. Open and add a new bookmark, File|New Bookmark to the folder you just created.
4. Select the new bookmark and edit its properties, Edit|Bookmark Properties, changing the url to http://www.mozilla.org.
5. Go back to the browser window and click on the New Folder in the personal toolbar. Click the New Bookmark item.

EXPECTED RESULTS
1. The New Folder should appear in the personal toolbar.
2. The link within the New Folder on the personal toolbar should function normally.

reference_cases.title: TC-184
reference_cases.description:
INITIAL CONDITIONS
1. All of the browser's toolbars(3) must be visible.
2. Make sure they are all visible by selecting the top level "View" menu and looking at the Toolbars submenu. The Navigation Toolbar, Personal Toolbar and Taskbar should all have checks next to their names.

STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Click here to load a page with an animated gif. Wait for it to stop.
2. Click the "Back" button on the Navigation toolbar. It looks like a left-pointing arrow.
3. Click the "Forward" button on the Navigation toolbar. It looks like a right-pointing arrow. Wait for the gif to stop.
4. Click the "Reload" button on the Navigation toolbar. It looks like a curved arrow.
5. Click the "Reload" button again, then quickly click the "Stop" button on the Navigation toolbar. It looks like an "X"

EXPECTED RESULTS
1. While the gif is animating the "Forward" and "Reload" buttons should be inactive and the "Back" and "Stop" buttons should be active. When the gif stops, the "Reload" button should be active and the "Stop" button should be inactive.
2. You should go back to the page you were at before. The "Forward" button should become active.
3. The "Forward" button should become inactive again.
4. The gif should begin to animate again.
5. The gif should stop mid-animation
